title: Godlessness in the Last Days, All Scripture Is Breathed Out by God

questions.question: But understand this, that in the last days there will come times of ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:1 (ESV): "But understand this, that in the last days there will come times of difficulty."

questions.question: For people will be lovers of ____, lovers of money, proud, arrogant, abusive, disobedient to their parents...
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:2 (ESV): "For people will be lovers of self, lovers of money, proud, arrogant, abusive, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, unholy,"

questions.question: They will have the appearance of godliness, but deny its ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:5 (ESV): "having the appearance of godliness, but denying its power. Avoid such people."

questions.question: Always learning and never able to arrive at a knowledge of the ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:7 (ESV): "always learning and never able to arrive at a knowledge of the truth."

questions.question: Just as ____ and ____ opposed Moses, so these men also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind and disqualified regarding the faith.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:8 (ESV): "Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these men also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind and disqualified regarding the faith."

questions.question: But they will not get very far, for their folly will be plain to all, as was that of those two ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:9 (ESV): "But they will not get very far, for their folly will be plain to all, as was that of those two men."

questions.question: You, however, have followed my teaching, my conduct, my aim in life, my faith, my patience, my ____, my steadfastness,
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:10 (ESV): "You, however, have followed my teaching, my conduct, my aim in life, my faith, my patience, my love, my steadfastness,"

questions.question: my persecutions and sufferings that happened to me at ____, at Iconium, and at Lystra...
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:11 (ESV): "my persecutions and sufferings that happened to me at Antioch, at Iconium, and at Lystra—which persecutions I endured; yet from them all the Lord rescued me."

questions.question: Indeed, all who desire to live a ____ life in Christ Jesus will be persecuted,
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:12 (ESV): "Indeed, all who desire to live a godly life in Christ Jesus will be persecuted,"

questions.question: while evil people and impostors will go on from ____ to ____, deceiving and being deceived.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:13 (ESV): "while evil people and impostors will go on from bad to worse, deceiving and being deceived."

questions.question: But as for you, continue in what you have learned and have firmly believed, knowing from whom you ____ it
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:14 (ESV): "But as for you, continue in what you have learned and have firmly believed, knowing from whom you learned it"

questions.question: and how from ____ you have been acquainted with the sacred writings, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:15 (ESV): "and how from childhood you have been acquainted with the sacred writings, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus."

questions.question: All Scripture is breathed out by ____...
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:16 (ESV): "All Scripture is breathed out by God and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for training in righteousness,"

questions.question: All Scripture is profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for training in ____,
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:16 (ESV): "All Scripture is breathed out by God and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for training in righteousness,"

questions.question: that the man of God may be complete, ____ for every good work.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 3:17 (ESV): "that the man of God may be complete, equipped for every good work."

key_verse_text: All Scripture is breathed out by God and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for training in righteousness, that the man of God may be complete, equipped for every good work.
